intro: Cape Verde is one of Africa's most stable democracies.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The prime minister leads the government; the president is elected separately. Power has changed hands peacefully several times.

chapters.title: Freedom
text: It is often ranked among the freest countries in Africa.

keyTerms.meaning: A system with both a president and a prime minister.

cardGroups.title: How power works
cardGroups.intro: Who chooses whom, and what each part of the system does.

steps.title: How a law is made
steps.intro: Most new laws follow these steps.

items.title: The President
items.text: Signs it or sends it back.
